# `banned-identifier`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: none · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports use of a project-configured identifier or dotted path.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Projects can prevent deprecated, unsafe, non-portable, or policy-incompatible
APIs and provide a migration hint at the use site.

## When it fires

The rule activates when `lints.banned` entries are configured; it has no
built-in project-specific blacklist.
